telegram.title: ZIAForge · maamul tusaalahaaga
telegram.helpBody:
/status — xaaladda barnaamijka
/projects — mashaariicda
/tasks [project-id] — hawlaha
/task task-id — xaaladda iyo tallaabooyinka
/run task-id — si cad u bilow ama u sii wad socodka shaqada
/pause task-id — jooji socodka shaqada
/screenshot — qabo daaqadda barnaamijka
/ask text — weydii kaaliyaha la doortay (ama dir farriin)
/new {JSON} — ku samee hawl adoo adeegsanaya createTask la cayimay
/command {"method":"...","args":[...]} — amar cad oo API ah

Oggolaanshaha xidhiidhka iyo sharciyada backend-ku waxay khuseeyaan amar kasta. Run ma oggolaato dukumenti ama qorshe. Go'aannadu waxay u baahan yihiin ID-yada hadda iyo dib-u-eegis. Farriimaha la diray ka hor hawlgelinta bot-ka lama fuliyo.

help.aiDescription: Jawaabuhu waxay isticmaalaan hagaha hadda jira iyo qaabeynta hore ee AI ee ku xiran. Wada-hadalkani ma maamuli karo arjiga mana oggolaan karo go'aannada hab-shaqeedka.
help.aiPreset: Qaabeynta hore ee AI ee ku xiran
help.aiSelectPreset: Dooro qaabeyn hore oo AI ah oo la kaydiyay
help.aiWelcome: Weydii sida loo isticmaalo ZIAForge, loo qaabeeyo hab-shaqeed, ama loo helo habayn. Jawaabuhu waxay xiriirin karaan qaybaha hagaha ee khuseeya.
help.aiOldAnswer: Jawaabtani waxay isticmaashay nooc hore oo hagaha ah. Dib u weydii si aad u hesho tilmaamaha hadda.
help.aiBusy: Kaaliyaha Caawintu hadda wuu jawaabayaa. Jooji ama sug ka hor inta aanad dirin su'aal kale.
help.aiInvalidRequest: Geli su'aal gaaraysa ilaa 12,000 xaraf oo dooro qaabeyn hore oo la kaydiyay.
help.aiInvalidResponse: AI-gu waxa uu soo celiyay jawaab maran ama si xad-dhaaf ah u dheer. Isku day mar kale.
help.aiStopped: Jawaabtii waa la joojiyay. Su'aashaadu weli way diyaar tahay.
help.aiFailed: Kaaliyaha Caawintu ma dhammaystiri karin jawaabtan. Hubi xiriirka AI ee la doortay oo isku day mar kale.
help.aiNativeRequired: CLI-kan asalka ahi waxa uu u baahan yahay oggolaanshaha kombuyuutar-gelitaanka ee milkiilaha. Ka kici heer maxalli ah gudaha Habaynta → Maamulka, ama dooro Claude Code ama qaabeyn hore oo API ah si aad u hesho fadhi Caawimo oo aan qalab lahayn.
help.aiPresetChanged: Qaabeyntan hore way isbeddeshay xilligii furitaanka. Dooro mar kale oo dib u tijaabi.
api_responses_text_16: Commands run locally after your approval. This is not an operating-system sandbox.
